title: Why it takes time to ramp up
caption: No shortcut through any of them.

before.label: Before
before.items: Sales deck, pricing, offering, business model

you-search-before-you-execute.description: A startup is a temporary organization designed to search for a repeatable and scalable business model; the facts a pipeline depends on are found in conversations with customers.[1]

customer-development-manifesto.title: Steve Blank, The Customer Development Manifesto

metrics-lag-by-the-cycle.description: A conversion figure for recent leads looks worse than the long-run value because those leads have not yet gone through a full sales cycle.[1]

science-of-scaling.title: Mark Roberge, The Science of Scaling

codify-after-you-learn.description: Roberge advises codifying the go-to-market playbook only after the learning, and proving scalable unit economics before aggressively hiring salespeople.[1]

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.keywords: sales deck, pricing, demo, proposal, contract, takes longer than you think
preparation.script: The first note is preparation. A sales deck. Pricing. An offering and a business model. A demo, meeting slides, a proposal. A contract, with compliance and legal covered. All of this has to exist before the first deal can close. Writing it takes longer than you think.

unknown-market.title: Unknown market
unknown-market.keywords: who, what they pay, which problem, months not days, the clock runs
unknown-market.script: The second note is the unknown market. Who is your customer? What will they pay? Which problem do they truly need solved? Until you know, every number on the cashflow board is a guess. Price, volume, timing: each rests on those three answers. The answers take months, not days. The clock on your cash keeps running meanwhile.

unknown-metrics.title: Unknown metrics
unknown-metrics.keywords: conversion rate and sales cycle unknown, plan backwards, only by selling
unknown-metrics.script: The third note is unknown metrics. At the start you do not know your conversion rate or your sales cycle. You need both to plan backwards from your cash. And you only get them by selling.

no-shortcut.title: No shortcut
no-shortcut.keywords: preparation, market, metrics, real time, start early
no-shortcut.script: Preparation, market, metrics. Each of the three takes real time, and there is no shortcut through any of them. You cannot rush them once the money is short. You can only start them early.
